name: hypertask_tokens
does: Mint an account MCP token or revoke signed account MCP tokens.
use_when: Use only when a human explicitly requests account credential administration.
do_not_use_when: Do not use for managed agent credentials; creating or revoking an identity uses hypertask_agents instead.
parameters_and_caveats: action selects an operation; input contains only that operation’s documented fields. response_format defaults to concise for reads; detailed retains full fields. limit defaults to 20 (maximum 50) and offset defaults to 0 for bounded read results; use returned pagination or narrower filters. expires_in_days sets token lifetime; revoke uses token or revoke_all. Mint returns a credential once; store it securely and never quote it in conversation.
